notes.title: Reviews are starting to roll in!
notes.content:
Reviews for Legacy of the Elder Star:

[list][*][url=https://gamerpros.co/legacy-elder-star-review/]GamerPros gives it 8.5 out of 10[/url]: "Legacy of the Elder Star knocks it out of the park, retaining the retro charm of the genre without shackling itself to the past."
[*][url=http://enemyslime.com/2016/06/review-legacy-of-the-elder-star/]Enemy Slime gives it 4/5[/url]: "The game runs like heaven, and controls wonderfully."[/list]

And from pre-launch coverage:

[list][*][url=http://ind13.com/legacy-elder-star-releases-next-week/]IND13 says[/url]: "The real treat, in my opinion, is the game’s art, hand-painted by artist Erik Exeter. The game is beautiful to look at, and screenshots look like they’re polished mock-ups or concept art."
[*][url=http://gameoctane.com/games/salt-lake-gaming-con-legacy-of-the-elder-star/]Game Octane says[/url]: "One of the things I respect most about this team is the addition of modes that are accessible to people with disabilities."[/list]

We've also been collecting Let's Plays on [url=https://www.youtube.com/playlist?list=PLH-s-s55OGESsU9C3dy5DbdiL5-6k13KX]our YouTube channel[/url]. Here are a couple we particularly like:

[list][*][url=https://youtu.be/NAf92aOwUJg]Yippee Ki Yay Mr Falcon[/url]
[*][url=https://youtu.be/BK2n_R2c91s]RobJNova[/url][/list]
